title: Contract-drift detection: implementation and spec verified against each other
asA: platform operator relying on the published contract
iWant: any divergence between the implementation and the served spec to fail the build
soThat: the spec clients integrate against is provably the service they call

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every routable endpoint in the implementation has a corresponding entry in the generated spec; an implemented-but-undeclared endpoint fails contract validation.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the implementation's route table and the generated spec
acceptanceCriteria.then: every implemented route appears in the spec, and a deliberately added undeclared route makes the comparison fail

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every entry in the generated spec has a live implementation; a declared-but-unimplemented operation fails contract validation.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the generated spec and the running service
acceptanceCriteria.then: none returns a routing-level 404 or 501; a deliberately orphaned spec entry makes validation fail

acceptanceCriteria.description: Observed response bodies match the spec's response schemas at the type level on every declared status code.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a representative request per declared operation and status
acceptanceCriteria.when: each observed response is validated against the spec schema
acceptanceCriteria.then: every response validates; a type-level mismatch fails the check naming the operation, status, and path into the schema

acceptanceCriteria.description: Contract validation runs in the build pipeline; drift on any of the three axes breaks the build rather than surfacing after deploy.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the build pipeline with an injected drift (undeclared endpoint, orphaned entry, or schema mismatch)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the build fails at the contract-validation step with a message naming the drift

acceptanceCriteria.description: The contract-validation report enumerates the checked operations so coverage is visible, not inferred.
acceptanceCriteria.then: every declared operation appears with its verification outcome
